bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
echo "GAYBBS_LINK_WORKTREE_AUDIT"
git status --short --untracked-files=normal | head -80
echo "LOCAL_BRANCHES"
git branch --list '*link*' '*profile*' '*integrate*' | head -50
echo "HEAD_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PR_COMMIT_PRESENT=$(git cat-file -e eca68464881ec4b26dc399f6c7323153232e2696^{commit} 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "COMPOSE_SERVICE"
docker compose -f deploy/gserver-compose.yaml config --services 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'gaybbs|postgres' || true
echo "GAYBBS_LINK_WORKTREE_AUDIT_END"
